build_pyomo_optimizer: build a nevergrad optimizer that wraps a Pyomo ConcreteModel for derivative-free optimization
convert_pyomo_variable_to_parametrizatio: convert a Pyomo variable component to a nevergrad parametrization dictionary with Scalar or Choice parameters
convert_pyomo_range_set_to_parametrizati: convert a Pyomo RangeSet domain to a nevergrad Scalar or Choice parameter with bounds
evaluate_pyomo_objective: evaluate a Pyomo model objective function expression and return the fitness value as a float
check_pyomo_constraints: check Pyomo scalar or indexed constraints and return whether they are satisfied as a boolean
